name: meeting-agenda-park
description: Park an agenda for a future principal call. Validates the agenda and writes it under /meetings/agendas/. The call loads it later; this does not start a call. Resolve sources into context text first — the call cannot fetch anything. Set scheduled_for when the call has a time. Expiry defaults to 7 days and cannot exceed 30.

inputs.title: string (required — short name, at most 120 characters)
inputs.topics: string[] (required — 1 to 10 ordered topics, each at most 200 characters)
inputs.context: string (required — text the spoken model can use, at most 6000 characters; no links it would have to fetch)
inputs.role: string? (optional stance for the call, at most 500 characters; never interpreted by code)
inputs.expires_at: string? (ISO timestamp; default 7 days from now, maximum 30 days)
inputs.scheduled_for: string? (ISO timestamp of the call this agenda is for)
